student_feedback: The library is quiet, clean, and a great place to study.
Campus Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting in the lecture halls.
The workshop was engaging and the instructor explained everything clearly.
The cafeteria queue is too slow between morning classes.
There are more study spaces in the new building.
The classroom projector did not work during our presentation.
The student support team was kind and helped me quickly.
The shuttle leaves at 8:30 from the north entrance.
The restrooms near the science block need better cleaning.
The campus garden looks beautiful this semester.
